analysis: The method skipLine calls scan.skip with a regex pattern. The documentation states that skip throws IllegalStateException if the scanner is closed. In the calling context, there is no check or validation ensuring the scanner is not closed. Therefore, the throwing condition for IllegalStateException is not avoided.
remark: The exception IllegalStateException is thrown when the scanner is closed. In the code, scan is used without any prior check for closed state. If the scanner has been closed before calling skipLine, this exception will be thrown.
